description: The decreasing-natural tree has a unique root, height omega, and every finite level nonempty and countable, but no cofinal branch; every branch is finite.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree_spec :
  (∃! r, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree r = 0) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.treeHeight Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree = Ordinal.omega 0 ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ),
          (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree ↑n).Countable ∧
            (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.level Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree ↑n).Nonempty) ∧
        (¬∃ B, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsCofinalBranch Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree B) ∧
          ∀ (B : Set Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree.carrier),
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.IsBranch Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteTrees.decreasingTree B → B.Finite
